guidance: Close Security Group ingress on ports 22 (SSH) and 3389 (RDP) open to 0.0.0.0/0. The preferred alternative is AWS Systems Manager Fleet Manager, which requires no open inbound ports — only an SSM Agent and an EC2 Instance Profile with AmazonSSMManagedEC2InstanceDefaultPolicy. If Fleet Manager is not feasible, use EC2 Instance Connect or restrict access to known IP ranges.
how_to_check: Are ports 22 and 3389 unrestricted (0.0.0.0/0) in any Security Group? Verify with Security Hub controls EC2.13 and EC2.14. Is Fleet Manager or another secure access method in use instead of direct SSH/RDP? For more information, please refer to the documentation.
